lines.t:
The ability to reduce the <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> from an
{{opponent}}'s <c:ffff00>attack<c>.

It is mostly determined by the <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>
stat of the <c:ffff00>legs<c>; the <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c> stat and <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>
also have an effect.

It rises temporarily when <c:ffff00>{{defend}}<c> is chosen in the
<c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> command.
